reviews.text:
Two weeks ago, my 13 year old Yorkie, Bella, needed to be rushed here from another hospital to have oxygen administered. She was having trouble breathing & the staff here took her in immediately upon entering & rushed to her service. Dr. Walsh was the vet on staff & she was truly one of a kind. She treated my mom and I as if she’s known us her whole life. Her patience and sincerity truly shined through, making us feel so comfortable to ask any questions or concerns we had. We went in not knowing what was wrong with Bella. Dr. Walsh was honest & broke down EVERY possible outcome , holding our hand.  Going to the ER Vet is never pleasant, but doc made us feel so at ease and helped plan our next steps. My mom and I went home that night feeling relieved to know there are good people out there. Especially a vet... one that truly loves what she does and cares about all her babies.

This is coming from someone who has three dogs. They are my world & I don’t trust ANYONE to care for them or watch them.

Thank you Dr. Walsh & the front staff at GSVS for letting us sleep easier knowing there’s a great place for our pets!

I have nothing but nice things to say about the entire staff at greater Staten Island! They have always been gracious kind and reassuring with me. I have taken my 7 year old French bulldog here multiple times throughout the years and have always left feeling a sense of relief! Dr. Pasaturo specifically has always been so thorough and so patient with my many many many questions and concerns! Thank you greater Staten Island for always taking great care of us!
10/10 recommend! the staff is so informative and kind and no matter the situation they always have a solution!

I’ve had a great experience with Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services. The staff is always kind, patient, and attentive, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals they treat. They take the time to answer questions, explain everything clearly, and make sure you feel comfortable with your pet’s care. I always feel like my pet is in good hands here. I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary team!

🐶🩵🩵Nacho absolutely loves coming here! He always feels so comfortable with the staff, which means so much to me because I know he’s in good hands. Everyone is always so kind, patient, and caring with him, and they treat him like he’s one of their own. I always leave feeling confident that Nacho received the best care. I’m so grateful to have a veterinary team I trust and that Nacho loves too. Highly recommend!🐶🩵🩵
Great and friendly staff very satisfied with our visit

Dr Walsh is absolutely wonderful! She took her time with our appointment, answered all our questions and concerns so thoroughly. Showed so much  genuine kindness and care through our whole visit. It is such a relief when you feel you can trust the people taking care of your loved ones! Thank you so much Dr Walsh and the staff there is just as wonderful everyone is so nice and welcoming and just answered everything you need. Thank you guys so much!

On Wednesday, my cat Gucci needed emergency help. I went to greater Staten Island veterinary services and it was a great experience.  I was greeted immediately, and after about five minutes, I was brought into the Examination room. I was greeted by Dr. Alexandra, Pasaturo and she had a very calming presence as I was so nervous. I would like to thank Dr. Pasaturo And the rest of the staff, namely Daisy, Kim, Brenda, and anyone else I forgot. Please accept my heartfelt gratitude for the empathy and compassion I was shown. Gucci says thank you you too.

Everyone was wonderful and treated me and my baby so kind. Everybody who worked there was kind caring and knowledgeable which made my visit easier.  This really made a difference because it allowed me to concentrate on my baby and the care that she needed.

The worst customer service I have ever experienced. The receptionist working around 10:00 PM on 8/5/2026 (I didn’t get her name) had a very rude and dismissive attitude.

We brought our dog in because he was having an emergency; he was repeatedly falling over, vomiting, and clearly not acting like himself. We waited for nearly an hour without anyone evaluating him or giving us any update. When I asked the receptionist, she simply said they were treating more critical cases first. While I completely understand that true life-threatening emergencies must be prioritized, my dog was visibly very sick, and there was no compassion, communication, or reassurance about his condition or how long the wait might be.

During an emergency, pet owners are already scared and worried. A little empathy and communication go a long way, and unfortunately, neither was shown to us.

Based on our experience, we will not be returning. If your pet is experiencing an emergency, I encourage you to consider all of your options before choosing this facility.

My niece had taken a 5 week old kitten which she found in the streets  to greater Staten Island veterinary hospital she wanted them to help save  his life .   She found two kittens alone in a puddle of water. The boy was vomiting and had diarrhea . The veterinary working that day thought the kitten had parvo , they   tested him twice first test was no result second was negative. Veterinary still believe the kitten had parvo regardless to the results. She recommended they should consider putting him down.  They said it will be very expensive try to save him and they didn’t know if they can save him. The 5 week old was euthanized . The next day the sister started vomiting and diarrhea, she was taken to another veterinary. The cause or the vomiting and diarrhea was due to worms which is so common in feral cats.   Greater Staten Island put down a kitten that could have been saved.

Every single person I met was wonderful, kind, efficient, caring, and knowledgeable. I wish I could remember everyone's name. We went in emergently on 7/19 around 9am Our mind was put at ease because everyone really cared and everyone was efficient and knowledgeable and didn't mind explaining and answering questions. They took great care of our male cat who had a urinary blockage and ultimately needed pu surgery. He’s Doing great we are 1 week post op.
Excellent care without long wait.   took great care of my dogs
They are so amazing and made my pup feel so much better 10/10 highly recommend

My dog Teddy was hit by a car in a hit-and-run on June 17th and was brought to Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services in critical condition. From the moment I called, I knew we were in good hands. They told me they would be ready for us, and when we arrived, the nurses were already waiting outside to take Teddy immediately. I was hysterical, but I never felt judged — only supported and cared for.

Dr. Flagiello came in as soon as she could to explain Teddy’s condition. He had suffered a traumatic brain injury, and she immediately began life-saving treatment that helped decrease the swelling in his brain and stabilize him. I truly believe that if Teddy had not been brought to Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services and treated by Dr. Flagiello, I am not sure he would be with us today. She gave him a chance to live, and I will forever be grateful for everything she did for him.

The nurses were incredible and took such great care of Teddy. They helped us through an overwhelming and frightening time and treated Teddy with such kindness and compassion. They also provided referrals for neurology care because of his brain injury and his inability to walk.

About a week and a half later, Teddy was readmitted due to breathing issues. Once again, the team took amazing care of him. When I arrived at 5:00 a.m., Dr. Walsh welcomed us and quickly rushed Teddy into oxygen, and I immediately knew he was safe.

Dr. Pasaturo was thoughtful and compassionate, helping us through Teddy’s challenges with eating, including placing a feeding tube and starting medications that helped restore his appetite. The nurses during this hospitalization were incredible as well, patiently working with Teddy to encourage him to eat. They celebrated every time he was able to eat, and those moments meant so much because it showed how much they truly cared about him. Even Dr. Flagiello celebrated Teddy’s progress, which showed the genuine compassion and dedication of the entire team.

Noelle was also amazing. She answered my countless phone calls, never lost patience with me, and always made me feel supported during such a frightening time.

Today, Teddy is walking again, doing physical therapy, eating, and slowly getting his personality back. I truly believe the care he received at Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services helped give him his life back. I cannot thank Dr. Flagiello, Dr. Pasaturo, Dr. Walsh, Noelle, the nurses, and the entire team enough. They are compassionate, dedicated, and truly care about the animals they treat. I would recommend them without hesitation.

We took my dog in for an examination due to potential heart complications, We ended up waiting over 2 hours with no updates as to when they’d be able to see us. Eventually when we went to ask if theres an estimate for how long until they can see us we were told “if you’re really concerned about your dog take them to our other hospital in Woodbridge, New Jersey” a 45 minute drive away. I’m very disappointed, the staff at intake were very nice but for the doctor to be dismissive and condescending like that was very upsetting. I wouldn’t suggest bringing your pets here.

Great veterinary! As soon as I got there, they took my baby in and gave her all necessary care she needed. Thanks to them my baby is feeling better  My Veterinarian who took care of my baby!  Everything!

I've been several times with my dog and I was always seen promptly and with kind and efficient doctors. They are all good. There has always been kindness of all staff, promptness of service,  and experience of the vet doctors.
Everyone was excellent from front desk to veterinarian.

Our beloved injured Labrador walked into the open arms of Dr. Christine Walsh, the most compassionate, passionate, caring, and exceptionally expert veterinarian that I had ever encountered, or even thought existed. My work has allowed me to be around many of the best in their fields, including some of the world’s top orthopedists, neurologists, and cardiologists, and none of them have anything on Dr. Walsh. Everything that she did was expert, including a bedside manner that should set the standard for all. She explained our Labrador’s issues so simply and thoroughly that we could make informed, intelligent decisions comfortably, and her ability to calm both our Labrador and us was impressive, as was everything she did.

No, I am not a friend nor a relative, and I had never met Dr. Walsh before last night. As you might imagine, she is the ONLY veterinarian who will treat our dogs, and I certainly believe it would be in everyone’s best interests to have her treat your most cherished and precious pets.

We are deeply appreciative and thankful for Dr. Walsh and the entire staff of  Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services who were all spectacularly caring, attentive, and skilled in their own right.

I cannot recommend this clinic highly enough.We had an emergency situation and my dogs’ veterinarian was out of town/ closed due to a holiday so this was our first time at the clinic. From the moment we walked in, the staff treated both me and my dog with the utmost respect and care. They are incredibly professional & very communicative but what truly stands out is their compassion and discretion. They were entirely transparent with me throughout the entire process, guiding us every step of the way so I always knew what to expect. Finding a team that balances high-level professionalism with genuine, empathetic care is rare. If you are looking for a veterinary team you can truly trust, look no further. Thank you all.

Rude staff !! One doctor !!!  The wait time is 5 hours.  You are better off waiting till the morning and going to a real clinic with experienced doctors.  Terrible service !!!!  And yes my cat was just as critical as every other animal. I would not have showed up here if it wasn’t critical.  Crazy high fever. Can’t eat kept licking her lips hyperventilating and apparently that’s okay to wait for 5 hours.   How is this emergency clinic if you don’t have enough doctors. ?! With this wait time you are better off waiting till the morning.  It’s literally the same wait but atleast you are waiting at home   Hate this place !!!!

They have a great staff over there that are both caring and compassionate . Dr. Rachel is the best and took great care of my cats. She even remembered me from over a year ago. Def go there in an emergency.
I lost my best friend today and the dr and staff were so kind. They helped me with what I needed to do and they were sympathetic to me. That means alot

My dog was attacked by a bigger dog , and I rushed to the ER. They took us immediately but the waiting time for the X ray was bit longer we'd expected. The doctor was caring and tried to help us. He also provided us with recommendations and discussed possible other health issues. Thank you all team for helping Foxy.

Can’t thank the staff enough for all there help with my Frenchie a few months ago. Dr. Walsh especially didn’t give up on figuring out what was wrong with my dog when other vets i went to kept brushing off my pets symptoms and signs. Thanks to her we figured out what was wrong and got the right medication! I’m very grateful for this place and will always use them in emergency!

Dr. Walsh was incredibly compassionate and attentive during our emergency visit. She took the time to answer all of my questions and address every concern, which made a stressful situation much easier. The service was excellent from start to finish, and we were seen immediately with virtually no wait time. I truly appreciated the professionalism, kindness, and care provided by Dr. Walsh and the entire staff. Highly recommend this animal hospital for emergency care.

I love everyone at GSIVS . They are so compassionate and on point with their diagnosing. 24 hour care is also a great plus. The only downside is the costs for petcare especially in today's times. My cat was diagnosed with FIP and at this point I'm ready to sell my kidney to save him. Dr Rachel Flagiello The care

Do not go here unless you have no other options. My dog got bit by a friends dog on a Sunday and we wanted to go get the wound cleaned because it was swelling. After waiting for over 2 hours, we brought her into see the vet and she completely fear mongered us. They hardly tried to treat her while she was awake and when they went to shave the area where she was bit, they buzzed too close to the wound and our dog got scared. They said they would have to sedate her with opiates to clean her and wanted to charge us over $1000 just to sedate her. They said she might get an infection, her leg might be broken, and that she was in severe pain even though she was expressing no signs of pain. When we said we didn’t want to sedate her they made it seem like we were bad pet owners. They then tried to push pain killers onto us, even though my dog was completely fine. We walked out with a $350 bill after they did absolutely nothing for us except give us amoxicillin that costs over $180. We brought our dog to our vet Monday am and they shaved her no problem. Said she was fine and not to worry. Costed $100.

I had to bring my dog, Fiona, here yesterday for an emergency visit, and we were seen by one of their emergency veterinarians, Dr. Pasaturo. She was absolutely amazing  friendly, caring, and extremely thorough during Fiona’s exam. She took the time to answer all of my questions and made sure I felt comfortable and informed every step of the way.

The staff was also wonderful. Sam, the veterinary technician, was incredibly kind, polite, and compassionate. Everyone was very quick with callbacks for any concerns, and the checkout process was fast and smooth, especially considering it was an emergency situation.

Of course, I hope I never have to bring Fiona back under emergency circumstances, but if I ever do, I would trust Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services without hesitation. Thank you to the entire team for taking such great care of my girl.

I want to thank everyone at Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services for taking the time and initiative to help me care for my baby cat Boba. From beginning to his discharge from surgery. The continued care and support I get from you has helped me to keep Boba healthy and alive . God bless you all for your hard work and genuine dedication to animals in the community.
< br />
< br />Kv Thank you Noel for your support, the reassurance and you response in explaining the entire process to me. The care, support and empathy for both the animals being treated and the people caring for them. This kind of empathy and willingness to help go hand in hand. Thank you for everything!☺️❤️👌

Very disappointing experience. I’ve been a loyal customer at this clinic and trusted them with my dog for a long time, but this visit felt extremely unprofessional and unfair.

I was almost unexpectedly charged over $620 without clear communication beforehand about the cost of each service, treatment, or medication. The pricing was never properly explained during the visit, and only afterward was I presented with a very high bill.

After arguing about the charges, they reduced the bill to around $300–$400, which I understood was supposed to include the medications my dog needed. However, I was then pressured into signing a separate $150 payment agreement for the medications — and still left without receiving them. Now I have to go purchase the medications elsewhere myself.

I also repeatedly asked to speak with the owner directly, but the staff would not allow me to contact or speak with her. As a long-time customer, this was extremely frustrating and disappointing.

I left feeling taken advantage of, unsupported, and without a real solution for my dog. I highly recommend that anyone visiting this clinic ask for written pricing and approval before agreeing to any treatment.

Very disappointed because I truly trusted this clinic and only came here for my dog’s care.

Each emergency visit my cat was looked at right away. The treatment of my animal was very good. The staff is very nice and caring. I don't remember names but literally everyone was great. That you were there to help when no one could see us.
The best there is..they care about their patients..
Caring, attentive, detailed, clean, & friendly. Giving my pup the meds she needed to stop throwing us and feeling nauseous was the best thing they did and my puppy was feeling much better after.

DO NOT take your pet here if there’s potential for a serious issue. Spent over an hour in the waiting room, additional 2 hours in a room without being seen by a vet only to be told they don’t have X-ray capability. Not a serious facility.

Great service, we were seen in a timely manner, everyone was very polite and took great care to examine our cat. I was grateful for the professionalism and kindness of all members of the healthcare team throughout the visit. I appreciated the communication about her assessment and detailed description about next steps / return precautions. Would definitely recommend to others and would hope to see her if we were ever in a similar situation (hopefully not though!)
Dr. Flagiello is excellence. She took such thorough care of our kitty of almost 17 years. Thank you from my heart 🩵🩵 …
Dr Walsh is amazing! I was a nervous wreck and she explained everything in great detail. The staff is so kind! Thank you The care my dog received

This place over charges so much and takes advantage of pet owners with sick animals. Their fees are 3x what other vets charge. It’s a sin what they do. $500 for blood work. $500 for X-rays etc. And on top of that misdiagnosed my dog that another vet caught. Spent over $1400 for nothing. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE !!!!!

We had to use this hospital twice. One time when my dog was hurt, and second, at the end of my poor puppy’s life. Each time we went in there, the hospital was clean and spotless. The staff was so lovely and wonderful. They were calm and caring, and so respectful of our circumstances. We cannot say enough good things about this pet hospital. Thank you to the nurses and doctors who cared so much for our dog!!

I am beyond words, after going here once I promise this place will never even cross my mind in an emergency.

My cat broke his leg, we came home and found him limping. We ran there to get care, and, they couldn’t get us out of the door quick enough. Telling us nothing was wrong. Charged us $250, my cat was screaming in pain when we made it home. We had to follow up with care, because for an xray they wanted another $490.

The staff is entirely unprofessional, we’re upset and stress over our baby boy and they are laughing and making jokes. We tried to follow up by phone with them to see if we should return to get them to give treatment, and they are laughing on the phone while trying to give us a email to send them pictures/videos of our cats injury too. They are young, inexperienced and un compassionate.

The girls on the overnight couldn’t have cared less, I’d give negative stars if I could.

UPDATE: I am beyond words and extremely upset and wish I could give less than one star. My poor boy has passed, he had a heart attack that night and a blood clot that subsequently got worse. We paid $500 and didn’t even get blood work that would have saved my boys life. The nurses were too busy laughing and having fun on the night shift, he passed two months later after suffering all that time. These vets had the chance to save my boy, instead they made money off my dying boy and brushed us off. Save your beloved pet, never come here ever.
